text: Main Courses PREP(Prerequisite Education Program) of CPA CANADA program compries 14 courses and is entailed within local accounting curriculum organized and tested by Liaocheng University. The program includes 9 core courses where original English CPA CANADA material are adopted. Duration 4 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor of Accounting(CPA CANADA)by Liaocheng University Future Career In commercial enterprises as accountant and financial affairs executive. Notes: Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.
